subject: The application failed to start error

messages.author: 82b3d4d57a69dd00
messages.subject: The application failed to start error
parts:
My application 

https://bdanielatl.shinyapps.io/RandomForestAccuracyModeler

started up, but it would never finish calculating the random forest.   I tried limiting the number of trees, but ever since I republished the app, it has stopped working altogether.  I have restarted the app, I even deleted it and re-published fresh from scratch, but to no avail, it refuses to load. The logs on my shiny server are blank.

 It works fine when I run it locally from my Mac RStudio instance. 

Thanks,

Ben

parts:
If you there no output in the logs then the problem must be with starting the R process to service your shiny application.

I noticed you have a 45MB .RData in your application folder. I think this might be causing a problem (though it shouldn't). Can you try removing that file?
